name: smwmusic-castlevania-ii-belmont-s-revenge-time-to-get-serious-psycho-warrior-remix
title: Castlevania II: Belmont's Revenge - Time to Get Serious!! ~ Psycho Warrior (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of the Rock Castle stage theme, Psycho Warrior from Castlevania II: Belmont's Revenge. Probably my favorite song in the entire OST (other than New Messiah, but it just got even better in Adventure Rebirth). Has this really serious vibe to it that leaks throughout the entire song and then ends on a big bang.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.
